title: Coefficients of powers of a combined polynomial ideal
statement: For any commutative ring R, ideal I of R and integers d,n ≥ 0, put Q = I R[X_1,…,X_d] + (X_1,…,X_d). A polynomial p belongs to Q^n if and only if, for every exponent E ∈ ℕ^d, its coefficient p_E belongs to I^(n−|E|), with truncated subtraction. Polynomial rings are [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring].

source.place: Tag 054L, lemma-smooth-etale-over-affine-space; explicit polynomial-model calculation of lem-trf-smooth-rational-point-completion, Step 6 (not a verbatim assertion of that tag).

proof.text: Embed polynomials in formal series and apply the combined power-series ideal coefficient criterion. The constants and variable generators map into the combined series ideal. This gives the necessary condition for |E|<n; for larger exponents the power is zero and the condition is automatic.

Conversely decompose p into its finite monomial sum. For each E, the variable monomial lies in the |E|-th power of the variables ideal, and its coefficient lies in I^(n−|E|). Their product lies in Q^(n−|E|+|E|), hence Q^n. Sum these memberships.

proof_origin.place: Explicit coefficient calculation in lem-trf-smooth-rational-point-completion, Step 6, formalized by M6.

theorem mem_combined_ideal_pow_iff
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (d n : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R) :
    p ∈ (I.map (C (σ := Fin d)) ⊔ idealOfVars (Fin d) R) ^ n ↔
      ∀ E : Fin d →₀ ℕ, p.coeff E ∈ I ^ (n - E.degree)
